evidence.claim: A policy naming a reason outside the closed taxonomy fails validation with on-failure-unknown-reason; the complete default map is silent (both-states).
Every taxonomy family has exactly one mapped policy: FAMILIES - keys = [] and keys - FAMILIES = [] (computed set difference).

implementation.parametrised_lookup: family_of('rail-exit-7') == 'rail-exit'; a policy key rail-exit-7 is out-of-taxonomy (keys are families, not codes)

negative_controls.description: Adding not-a-timeout as an on_failure key must fire on-failure-unknown-reason; DEFAULT_ON_FAILURE must stay valid.
A substring resolver (family in reason) maps not-a-timeout to the timeout action; family_of/resolve_on_failure reject it. AST confirms production code has no `in reason` compare.
Deleting timeout from the default map makes FAMILIES-keys == {timeout} and validation emits on-failure-family-unmapped.
